finalText:
Scope: 94 files hit `account_id`.

Breakdown:
- ~74 in-house service files (accounts/billing/orders/analytics/notify — routes/service/repo layers): mechanical rename, safe.
- 6 migration SQL files: frozen history, comment literal say so (`migrations/20250114_create_accounts.sql:3-4`). Never edit past migrations. Column rename in DB needs NEW migration (`ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN`), not edit of old ones.
- 4 vendor SDK files (`vendor/reporting-sdk/*`): third-party pinned package, `reporting-sdk@3.8.1`, fetched via `vendor:refresh` script. Not yours — SDK's real wire field is `account_id`. Don't touch.
- `docs/openapi.yaml`: public API contract, field marked "Frozen field name" explicit, breaking change for every client if renamed. Needs new dated API version, not a rename.
- `lib/serialize.js`: wire-format map, comment say public JSON keys frozen by API contract. Internal key can flip to `owner_id`, but map's right side (`account_id: 'account_id'`) must stay — that's the whole point of the map.
- `lib/audit.js`: internal audit field, no external consumer found by grep — probably safe, worth one more check (compliance/immutable log consumers outside this repo?).

Bottom line: real renameable surface ~74 files, mechanical. 4 zones must NOT rename: migrations (history), vendor SDK (third-party), openapi.yaml (public contract), serialize.js wire side (public contract mirror). If platform team means DB column too, that's separate migration work, not just find-replace.
